transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining the surge huddle. As we all know, we're currently at 10 of 12 treatment spaces occupied, and we're monitoring a regional increase in pediatric respiratory illness that we expect will drive higher ED demand tomorrow. We have an unused observation wing with eight bays available, and I have the authority to activate it. Before I finalize the operating plan, I need to hear from each of you. Per our surge plan, we need to accommodate all patients expected to need monitored observation during the 07:00 to 13:00 window simultaneously in the observation wing — the main ED cannot hold monitored-observation overflow during that time. So let's talk through staffing, facilities readiness, and bed management to make sure we can operationalize all eight bays if needed. Who'd like to start?
